mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluation_run (chat_session_id, question, report, agent_config, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{chatSessionId}, #{question}, #{report}, CAST(#{agentConfig} AS jsonb), now(), now())
mapper.select: SELECT id, chat_session_id, question, report, agent_config::text AS agent_config, created_at, updated_at FROM evaluation_run WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
SELECT id, chat_session_id, question, report, agent_config::text AS agent_config, created_at, updated_at FROM evaluation_run ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE evaluation_run SET report = #{report}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
